**In one line**: Al Jazeera reports that former OpenAI employees say they were fired after raising safety concerns inside the company.

### Key points
- Al Jazeera published the former employees' account on October 9. They link their dismissals to the safety issues they raised.
- Details such as when they were fired, how many people were involved and what concerns they raised should be checked in the original report. So far these are the former employees' allegations.
- It was not clear at the time of the report whether OpenAI had publicly responded to the claims.
- OpenAI has faced criticism before over non-disparagement terms for departing staff and over people leaving its safety teams. These allegations are drawing attention against that background.

### Why it matters
Whether staff at frontier AI labs can raise safety concerns freely is widely seen as a safeguard as important as outside regulation. If the allegations hold up, they could shape debate over whistleblower protections for AI researchers and affect trust in OpenAI's governance.
